notes: Every lantern has two upgrade paths with 5 tiers each, replacing the old 6 levels. Tap a lantern to open its upgrade panel.
Max both paths to ascend. Each lantern has three ascension types: its original perk plus two new ones.
Mastery unlocks upgrades: path 2 at 10, tier 4 at 20, tier 5 and the first ascension at 30, the second and third ascension types at 50 and 70, and a Radiant look at 100.
New upgrade effects include multi-target shots, crits, armor piercing, burns, marks that make foes take more damage, splash, and lingering fire, acid and ice on the trail.
Endless runs saved before this update can’t be continued.
title: Paths
